CM.name: IRCM on dividends (15 % final + 10 % communal additional centimes)
CM.doc: art. 70 (1): final rate of 15 % on capital income; art. 71: the tax is increased by 10 % communal additional centimes (16,5 % in all).
unsupported: 30 % on income paid to tax-haven residents (art. 70 (1))

CM.name: IRCM on interest (15 % final + 10 % CAC)
unsupported: exemptions of savings interest under the CGI's IRCM exemption list (not applied)

CM.name: Employer contributions to the Crédit Foncier (1,5 %) and the Fonds National de l'Emploi (1 %)
CM.statute: Law on the CFC and FNE contributions as annexed to the CGI 2024 (art. 6: CFC 1 % employee / 1,5 % employer, FNE 1 %)
CM.doc: art. 6 of the annexed law: CFC employer 1,5 % and FNE 1 % of gross wages (2,5 % in all; an older annexed version prints CFC employer 2,5 % without FNE: same total).
unsupported: two versions of art. 6 annexed (later version used)
base rounded down to the thousand
CNPS employer contributions (rates outside the CGI)

CM.name: Registration duty on transfers of urban built property (intermediate rate 10 %)
CM.doc: art. 543: intermediate rate 10 % on acts and transfers of urban built property; average rate 5 % on urban unbuilt and rural built property; reduced 2 % on rural unbuilt property and share transfers.

CM.name: Registration duty on transfers of urban unbuilt land (average rate 5 %)
unsupported: rural unbuilt land 2 % (art. 543 d)

CM.name: Taxe sur la propriété foncière (0,1 % of the declared value of land and buildings)
CM.statute: CGI 2024 art. 577, 580, 581 (1); the 2026 edition moves it to art. C 53 with a progressive schedule above 500 M (date of that change not established)
CM.doc: art. 581 (1): 0,1 %; art. 580: on the value of land and buildings declared by the owner (administrative value if none or understated); due in the chief towns of administrative units and serviced areas (art. 577).
unsupported: exemptions (art. 578: public bodies, schools, industrial plant buildings, agricultural land)
progressive schedule above 500 M FCFA in the 2026 edition (art. C 53 (2))

CM.name: Droits de mutation par décès (progressive 2 / 3 / 5 %)
CM.doc: art. 544 B b): bracket 0-2 000 000 2 %; 2 000 001-5 000 000 3 %; above 5 000 000 5 %, whatever the relationship.

CM.name: Droits de mutation entre vifs à titre gratuit (5 / 10 / 20 % by relationship)
CM.doc: art. 544 B c): direct line and between spouses 5 %; between brothers and sisters 10 %; other relatives beyond the second degree and non-relatives 20 %.

BJ.name: IRCM on dividends (10 %)
BJ.statute: CGI 2023 art. 86 2) (edition 2023, later finance laws not held)
BJ.doc: art. 86: 10 % on dividends other than those paid to non-residents or by listed companies (5 %); 15 % on other capital income.
unsupported: 5 % on dividends of companies listed on the BRVM and to non-residents (art. 86 1)

BJ.name: IRCM on interest from claims and deposits (15 %)
Impôt sur les revenus fonciers (12 %)
unsupported: 4 000 F ORTB fee per assessment (art. 104 2)

BJ.name: Taxe sur les plus-values immobilières (5 % of the gain)
unsupported: minimum of 1 % of the sale price (art. 115 2)
exemptions (art. 110)
construction gain set at 10 % of its price (art. 113)

BJ.name: Versement patronal sur salaires (4 %)
unsupported: 2 % for private schools (art. 194)
exemptions (art. 192)

BJ.name: Taxe foncière unique (default rates 6 % built on rental value, 5 % unbuilt on administrative value)
BJ.statute: CGI 2023 art. 157-159 (art. 159 as amended by LF 2023)
BJ.doc: art. 159: councils set rates within 4-8 % (built) and 3-7 % (unbuilt); where no rate is adopted, 6 % built and 5 % unbuilt; art. 157: built property on its rental value; art. 158: land on its administrative value.
unsupported: council rates within the 3-8 % ranges
additional levies on top of the TFU (art. 159 3)
temporary exemption of new owner-occupied buildings (art. 154)

BJ.name: Registration duty on transfers of immovable property (5 %)
unsupported: exchanges 2 % (art. 332)

BJ.name: Registration duty on gifts inter vivos (5 %)
Inheritance tax
BJ.why: BJ: art. 394 1) — transfers on death are registered free of duty (gifts inter vivos 5 %, modelled)
